name: – Gheorghe Falcă – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on the deliberations of the Committee on Petitions in 2023
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its views on how the petitions committee worked in 2023. It asks for better public information about the right to petition, clearer explanations of what the EU is responsible for, and faster, more transparent answers from the Commission and Member States when citizens complain about breaches of EU law. It also calls for a more accessible petitions website. The report does not change any law; it is a set of opinions and requests.

- **What changes:** Nothing in law. It asks for better information campaigns, a more accessible petitions portal, and faster replies from the Commission and national authorities.
- **Who is affected:** EU citizens and residents who petition Parliament, plus the Commission and Member State authorities responding to them.
- **What happens next:** The resolution is sent to the Council, the Commission, the Ombudsman and national governments and parliaments; follow-up depends on them.
